svg.aria-label: An agent asked to train on a free 24 GB GPU runs fleet ls, picks the idle RTX 4090, starts the job there, then flags an idle rental that costs money.
svg.title: fleet: your agent finds a free GPU and uses it

g.text: train train.py on whatever has a free 24 GB card
